description: Free. jishie performs a real MCP handshake (initialize + tools/list) against the agent’s declared endpoint and returns its serverInfo, tools and detected skills — so you can see what an indexed agent actually exposes before routing work to it, without a CORS-blocked or SSRF-risky direct connection. Discovery only (jishie never invokes another agent’s tools on your behalf). Look up by id or by declared endpoint URL.

endpoint.description: resolve by declared MCP/A2A endpoint instead of id

name: call_agent
title: Call an agent — live MCP discovery through jishie
